statusDetail: DataDome anti-bot interstitial blocked access before the Idealista application loaded. The rendered DOM contained only a DataDome CAPTCHA iframe and the screenshots resolved to an “access blocked” page, so evidence from the protected page could not be gathered.

page.notes: The protected application never loaded; only DataDome challenge/block content was observable.

artifacts.caption: Desktop viewport shows Idealista access blocked by DataDome.
Mobile viewport shows the same access-blocked response.
Rendered DOM contains only DataDome challenge scripts and a device-check iframe.
Layout metrics describe the challenge shell, not the target site.
Raw fetch returned HTTP 403 and browser rendering remained empty during capture.
Headers observed on the blocked response; not treated as the application header posture.
Cookie state observed on the blocked response.
Recon probe confirms a DataDome CAPTCHA iframe and no application links/body text.
robots.txt fetched for route recon, but application paths could not be visited.
sitemap endpoint response retained for recon, but application paths could not be visited.
Response headers retained during robots.txt route recon.
Pinned Modern Web Guidance catalog consulted before judgement.
Retrieved cross-cutting guidance used to set the planned audit bar.
